evidence: The primary vegetable list explicitly gives Hindi पत्तागोभी cabbage. CDIAL 7733 attests Hindi pattā leaf; CDIAL 4270 gives Hindi gobī/kopī/gobhī cabbage. Two ordered component links to the existing Hindi lexical nodes represent leaf + cabbage. Regional length, gemination and gobi/gopi aspiration/voicing notation are preserved; these identify the lexical components without claiming an inherited Sanskrit compound or a settled route of local Indo-Aryan transmission.
